Dual_Screening.A2: Independent screening completed for 197 records; original reviewer decisions and all 26 resolution notes preserved. Human independence confirmed by the team on 7 November 2026.
Dual_Screening.A3: Follow-up: 45 records advanced for retrieval; five included, three excluded after full-text assessment, 37 not retrieved. Column E retains the original pre-reconciliation first pass.
Dual_Screening.I9: SHAP and LIME are used descriptively on cement workability, and no explanation stability is measured. Fails IC3. Resolved: Exclude (EC1).
Dual_Screening.I11: XAI is added to a crop recommender for transparency only. Stability is not a stated aim or a reported outcome. Resolved: Exclude (EC1).
Dual_Screening.I16: Gradient boosting for photovoltaic performance. The title shows no SHAP/LIME explainer or stability outcome, so it fails IC2 and IC3. Resolved: Exclude (EC1).
Dual_Screening.I24: Complete publisher abstract: QRF intervals concern WPI predictions; SHAP identifies drivers, with no separate attribution-stability outcome. Resolved: Exclude (EC1). Source checked 7 Nov 2026: https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/11482437
Dual_Screening.I30: Complete publisher abstract: SHAP-RFE is evaluated through predictive accuracy, Brier score and ECE, rather than measured attribution stability. Resolved: Exclude (EC1). Source checked 7 Nov 2026: https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/11257482
Dual_Screening.I32: Perovskite formability prediction, a materials application with no explanation-stability outcome. Resolved: Exclude (EC1).
Dual_Screening.I34: Abstract and runtime-verification framework: explanation coherence and physics grounding filter decisions; no repeated/perturbed attribution-stability outcome is separately evaluated. Resolved: Exclude (EC1). Source checked 7 Nov 2026: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.20675v1
Dual_Screening.I35: A text-only NLP spam classifier, so it fails IC1, and no stability analysis is evident. Resolved: Exclude (EC2).
Dual_Screening.I36: Complete publisher abstract: bootstrap variation concerns biomass predictions; SHAP reports contributions/interactions, without an attribution-stability outcome. Resolved: Exclude (EC1). Source checked 7 Nov 2026: https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/11727032
Dual_Screening.I37: Counterfactual and prototype explanations are not in the SHAP/LIME family. Resolved: Exclude (EC3).
Dual_Screening.I38: Ano2Rule gives rule-based global interpretation of anomaly detectors, not SHAP/LIME, and does not study stability. Resolved: Exclude (EC3).
Dual_Screening.I47: BorutaSHAP is used for feature selection in stock prediction. SHAP reliability is not an outcome. Resolved: Exclude (EC1).
Dual_Screening.I50: Resilience of propagation models for digital twins, a communications topic with no SHAP/LIME stability outcome. Resolved: Exclude (EC1).
Dual_Screening.I68: Friction stir welding prediction and optimisation with ensembles, an engineering application. Fails IC2 and IC3. Resolved: Exclude (EC1).
Dual_Screening.I83: Landslide susceptibility mapping with explainable ensembles. It is an applied study, consistent with the exclusion of N005. Resolved: Exclude (EC1).
Dual_Screening.I86: Bi-LSTM forecasting of seismic magnitude. The “limitations” in the title are model performance limits, not explanation limits. It is also a time-series model, not tabular. Resolved: Exclude (EC2).
Dual_Screening.I97: An experimental geotechnical study with predictive modelling and no SHAP/LIME explainer. Fails IC2 and IC3. Resolved: Exclude (EC1).
Dual_Screening.I114: Concrete strength prediction with banana leaf ash, an application study with no stability outcome. Resolved: Exclude (EC1).
Dual_Screening.I121: Bayesian Shapley valuation of economic inputs is outside SHAP/LIME feature attribution for ML. Resolved: Exclude (EC3). Source: https://mpra.ub.uni-muenchen.de/74747/1/MPRA_paper_74747.pdf
Dual_Screening.I131: Consumer behaviour forecasting where explanations come from the knowledge-graph model itself, not SHAP/LIME, and with no stability measurement. Resolved: Exclude (EC3).
Dual_Screening.I179: Spatiotemporal regression of urban morphology and carbon emissions, an urban-science application with no explanation-stability outcome. Resolved: Exclude (EC1).
Dual_Screening.I184: Publisher abstract and introduction: the proposed and evaluated explainer produces counterfactuals, outside the SHAP/LIME attribution family. Resolved: Exclude (EC3). Source checked 7 Nov 2026: https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0957417423007169
Dual_Screening.I186: Gated-attention soft sensor for industrial processes. The uncertainty quantification is on model outputs, not on SHAP/LIME explanations. Resolved: Exclude (EC1).
Dual_Screening.I188: Machine learning on corn fibre gum–soy protein emulsifying properties, a food-chemistry application with no stability outcome. Resolved: Exclude (EC1).
Dual_Screening.I199: The paper (R2ET, NeurIPS 2024) is about stable explanations, which is why Saif included it. But the explainers it targets are gradient-based saliency methods, not SHAP/LIME, and the abstract and paper show no SHAP/LIME analysis. Fails IC2. Resolved: Exclude (EC3).
Dual_Screening.I202: “Inference to the Stable Explanations” is a philosophy-of-science paper on abductive reasoning. It has no ML, tabular data or SHAP/LIME. The word “stable” caused the title match. Resolved: Exclude (EC5).
